caption.text:
A saloon that runs the quarter mile in the nines and still takes four adults and the luggage.

Under two seconds to sixty, with the roof rack still fitted.

· 1,020 hp from three motors, and a quarter mile in 9.23 seconds.
· 1.99 seconds to 60 mph — with rollout subtracted, which is the footnote that starts every argument.
· 359 miles EPA range, from the same car that will run a nine-second pass.

2025 Tesla Model S Plaid
1020 hp · 0–60 mph in 1.99 sec* · 200 mph · 359 mi EPA

The asterisk is fair game. The nine-second quarter mile, from a five-seat saloon, isn't.

Does rollout belong in a 0–60 time?
